source_message.text:
Salma [FREELANCER_NAME_001]

Below is the initial feedback from our customer. Please tell me what you think.

Proposal \(Indstilling\):
• Placeholder fields: Unlike the Executive Summary, clicking the "insert" fields \(Advantages, settings, attachments, headline, and date\) does not automatically remove the existing text.
• Text boxes: When the text boxes on the left side, including the headline, run out of room, they do not wrap the words automatically. Instead, the right-hand column is pushed farther to the right.
• Line breaks: As a result, users must add line breaks manually. Unfortunately, using a "normal" line break \(hard return\) creates too much line spacing. That spacing works well between bullet points, but it is excessive for continuous text. A "soft return" \(Shift\+Enter\) works, although I doubt our colleagues know how to use it.
• Date function: Could the date functionality used in the "Board Seminar" document also be implemented here?
Guidance \(Vejledning\):
• Margins: The margins beneath the "\(short description\)" section are not fixed. Without manual line breaks, the "pencil" icon is progressively cut off. Can fixed margins be configured?
• Theme description: This has the same problem described in point 3 under "Proposal."
• Reflections: The section under "\(write own reflections, if any\)," has the same problem as point 1 under "Proposal."
Board Seminar \(Bestyrelsesseminar\):
• Multi-line support: Users must be able to enter multiple lines beneath "Item and Title." Manual line breaks need to work in this area.
• Agenda: The section under "\(insert agenda\)," has the same problem as point 1 under "Proposal."
Board Meeting \(Bestyrelsesmøde\):
• Date function: Can this document use the same date functionality found in the "Board Seminar" document?
• Alignment: "Item and Title" does not line up with "Topic," "Proposal," and "Start time."
• Formatting issues: Adding another line directly after a "Topic" also creates an additional horizontal line/border. Adding a line in other places behaves correctly.
Master:
• Review: [CLIENT_NAME_001] and I need to review this because the bullet sizes and spacing still look wrong on my screen.
• Tables: I need a walkthrough or explanation showing how the tables function.
• Color palette: All these colors should not be available as choices.
